name: Ursangous's Paw
summary: The Ashenvale Hunt has brought you Ursangous's Paw. Take it to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, and earn honor among the Horde's trackers.

sections.title: A Trophy of the Great Hunt
sections.body: Trackers from Splintertree Post hunt the ancient beasts that rule Ashenvale's canopy. Ursangous is among the fiercest. He kills travelers and warriors who cross his path, so his paw proves the mighty beast has fallen to your hunt.

sections.title: The Night Elf Connection
sections.body: A quarter-crescent mark appears on Ursangous's paw, carved or pressed into it. Senani Thunderheart recognizes the sign as kaldorei influence. Night elves train and bond with formidable forest beasts to guard their sacred borders. Ursangous may have guarded those borders or served the Alliance as a weapon.

faq.answer: Ursangous is an exceptionally massive and deadly bear who roams Ashenvale. Hunters and wayfarers fear him. He claimed countless lives before the Horde hunt brought him down.

faq.q: What does the crescent emblem on the paw mean?
faq.answer: The quarter-crescent mark on Ursangous's paw is a mystery when you inspect the trophy. Senani Thunderheart can examine it when you bring her the paw.

faq.q: Who do I bring Ursangous's Paw to?
faq.answer: Bring Ursangous's Paw to Senani Thunderheart, the tauren huntress at Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: How does this fit into the Ashenvale Hunt?
faq.answer: Ursangous is one of three great beasts hunted in Ashenvale, alongside Shadumbra and Sharptalon. Defeat all three and present their trophies to complete the rite.

faq.q: Why is the Horde hunting the great beasts of Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Horde hunters at Splintertree Post, especially tauren and orcs, hunt these deadly beasts to test their martial prowess. They also curb threats near vulnerable supply lines and encampments.

faq.q: What happens after turning in the paw?
faq.answer: After you collect Ursangous's trophy and those of the other designated quarry, Senani Thunderheart will acknowledge your triumph in the concluding trial, The Hunt Completed.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter, taking Ursangous's paw honors the beast. It shows your martial resolve and respect for the spirits of the hunt.
As a member of the Horde, you can earn honor at Splintertree Post by defeating the dangerous Ursangous.
As a hunter, tracking and defeating one of Ashenvale's oldest and deadliest predators tests your fieldcraft, survival, and combat skill.
